answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in wander, expire in river, and ledge lists each expiry. An adversary running 73 aliases therefore needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1557 identities would post 2384 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
